TZA.note: Nothing on civil servant digital training.

facts.fact: UCSAF's CEO said as of March 2025 430 of the 758 towers of the Digital Tanzania Project had been built and were serving rural residents, to cover 713 wards in 127 districts.

TZA.note: Only teacher ICT training (3,798 teachers); not training of the public.

facts.fact: UCSAF said it has allocated 1.8bn/- to provide assistive ICT equipment, including Braille machines and voice recorders, to 22 schools for students with special needs.
UCSAF said it has earmarked 700m/- for ICT equipment for ten vocational training institutions in the 2024/25 financial year.

TZA.note: ICT equipment to 1,121 schools is a device programme; no internet share or curriculum statement.
